craft_notes: Sthāyin: net-question (Indra-net-shine stood up, then asked: what reality OF net? — firmness answers with calm-going). Rows: row 2 (standing→goes). Close: goes (calm GOES: śama as motion from firmness). Rejected: answering the net-question — killed: asked kept (the verse asks FROM firmness; the asking is the firmness); 'illusion' — killed: non-reality kept (asat as the verse's first word, ontological not epistemic).

lines: what reality of net? From firmness — calm goes.
